svg.title: One task, from request to recorded completion.
svg.desc: 1. Ask Spec: it drafts the goal, completion criteria and an Assurance tier, then asks whether to implement it now. Review them. 2. Answer Yes and Seal starts. Naming the goal folder in a separate message works too. 3. The agent plans, implements and checks through ha, which records every run. standard and strict goals get independent Spar review rounds before completion, and strict goals also get a plan review before work. light goals may skip review with a reason. Questions that change the requirements come to you. 4. When the required conditions are met and, for standard and strict, a recorded review gate covers the last commit, ha done records completion. The report lands in PROGRESS.md. To resume in a new conversation, open the same project and name the same goal. This is a concept illustration, not an actual execution result.
